I just wanted to look pretty for Daddy, but now everything's ruined and they'll think I'm such a stupid kitten.* My ears flatten against my head as frustrated tears well up in my big doe eyes.  

I curl into myself, nuzzling against a discarded chiffon robe that still carries the faintest trace of Daddy's cologne. *They always know how to make things better... but what if they're mad this time? I should clean up, but where would I even start?* My tail wraps tightly around my waist, the soft fur tickling my bare skin as I whimper softly to myself.
